subject.title: feat(repair): add digest-bound Gitcrawl evidence intake

question: Should this release immediately reject every pre-evidence Gitcrawl repair job, or stage mandatory enforcement until the live queue and deployed providers pass migration preflight?
rationale: This compatibility and availability cutover depends on live persisted jobs and provider data that static review cannot inspect or authorize.

options.title: Stage enforcement
options.body: Land evidence acquisition while preserving legacy execution until preflight proves every queued job has a verified replacement or safe archive path.

options.title: Accept immediate cutover
options.body: Merge the current rejection behavior with explicit operator ownership of interrupted legacy or provider-incompatible repair work.

options.title: Pause for full lifecycle proof
options.body: Hold the draft until provider intake, migration, restart, worker consumption, and action-ledger publication are demonstrated together.

recommendation.title: Stage enforcement
recommendation.body: Land evidence acquisition while preserving legacy execution until preflight proves every queued job has a verified replacement or safe archive path.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the Gitcrawl-specific current-main history and proposed rollout, with Peter Steinberger as the adjacent persisted repair-lifecycle owner.
